_comment: Act 2 script for the Forgotten Forest.

objectives.wall: Find a way through the quarantine wall
objectives.tune: Tune the radio tower to the carrier wave
objectives.tunnel: Follow the opened road to the service tunnel
objectives.warden: Something guards the tunnel. Put it down.

side_objectives.cache: Optional: find the hunter's cache past the ford
side_objectives.patrol: Optional: learn what happened to Patrol Kestrel (%d / 2)

hints.wolves: Corrupted wolves hunt in packs and hear further than Hollows. Stay low or fight with your back to a tree
hints.ford: The ford is shallow. Water is loud: cross slowly
hints.warden: The Warden's swing can be parried. Its charge cannot: dodge sideways
hints.warden_2: Its armour is gone. When it roars and plants its feet, get behind a pillar
hints.warden_3: The suit is failing. After each lunge it is wide open

arrive.speaker: Oren
arrive.text: That's the old cordon ahead. Army put it up in a night. Have a look which way the guns point, son.

tower.speaker: Oren
tower.text: That mast controls the cordon gates. It listens for one carrier and nothing else. Get it tuned and the service road opens.

tuned.speaker: Oren
tuned.text: That's her. Gate's cycling. Service tunnel's east of you, past the checkpoint.

tuned.speaker: Kael
tuned.text: You know this place well for a man with old maps.

arena.speaker: Oren
arena.text: Kael. Stop. There's a suit at that gate. Army exo-frame. There was a man in it once.

cache.speaker: Kael
cache.text: A whetstone and a note. Somebody decent lived out here.

patrol.speaker: Kael
patrol.text: "Tell him I saw." ...Hale. That name was on the report.

intro.speaker: Kael
intro.text: Birds. I'd forgotten there were birds.

intro.speaker: Oren
intro.text: Enjoy them while they last. They stop singing near Meridian. You'll hear where.

confession.speaker: Oren
confession.text: I know that gate. I know the weight of the bar. Twenty years and my hand still closes on it in my sleep.

confession.speaker: Oren
confession.text: I sealed that tunnel, son. On an order. With your mother and your sister on the other side of the glass.

confession.speaker: Oren
confession.text: She told me it was all right. I've been trying to find someone to tell me it wasn't.

confession.speaker: Kael
confession.text: ...Stay on the radio, Oren. You're going to open it with me.

wall: The gate is shut. Follow the wall to find another way through.
Follow the quarantine wall north from the gate to where it has fallen in, and climb through the breach.
tower: Head for the radio mast to the south-east.
Follow the trail past the outpost, over the river ford, to the radio hut under the tall mast.
tune: The radio hut has a panel and the operator's log.
Read the operator's log in the hut for the frequency and strength, then press E at the panel and match both.
tunnel: Follow the road east through the inner gate toward the service tunnel.
warden: Hide from the flame and hit it after a charge.
Stay behind the yard's pillars when it breathes fire. After it charges and slams it has to recover: that is the moment for heavy attacks or the axe.
enter: The tunnel mouth is past the Warden's yard.
Go to the far east end of the yard and press E at the service tunnel.
